platforms.note: 2026 national platform 'Workers Deserve More' (released July 2026). dsausa.org returned 403; planks taken from news coverage, not the DSA document. Semafor reports it is not binding on endorsees; several candidates distanced themselves.
planks: Universal healthcare free at point of service
32-hour workweek with no pay cut, living minimum wage, paid family leave
Stronger union and strike protections
Aggressive wealth taxes on the richest people and corporations
Public ownership of the largest corporations and essential industries
Publicly owned social housing
Free public college and cancellation of student debt
Abolish ICE, legalize migration, amnesty for immigrants already here
Phase out fossil fuels

Structural democracy changes: abolish the Senate, national popular vote, larger House by proportional representation, multi-party system, curb judicial review, voting rights for people with convictions and noncitizens

platforms.note: Required pledge (2026): no money from corporate PACs, AIPAC, crypto or AI lobbies. Policy list is the group's published platform.
planks: Refuse corporate PAC, lobbyist, AIPAC, crypto and AI-industry money (required pledge)
Medicare for All
Green New Deal
Tax the rich; expand Social Security
Cancel student debt; free public college and trade school
Living wage, federal jobs guarantee, stronger unions
Housing as a human right
Democracy reform and voting rights; immigrant rights
Progressive foreign policy

platforms.note: No formal 2026 candidate pledge found; planks are from its homepage framing ('Fight Trump & the Oligarchs' 3-point strategy). It also signed on to the CPC Affordability Agenda.
planks: Fight oligarchy and corporate power ('Defund Oligarchy')
Get big, corporate and dark money out of politics
Medicare for All
Affordability / cost-of-living economic populism
Workers' rights and collective bargaining
Opposition to war funding
Primary challenges and new leadership for Democratic Party establishment

platforms.note: 2026 national agenda 'Working Families Guarantee' (April 2026); full text not retrieved, planks from NOTUS/Mother Jones coverage.
planks: Federal jobs program offering union jobs to offset AI-driven job losses
Affordable housing
Guaranteed low-cost childcare
12 weeks paid family and medical leave for all workers
Single-payer health care
Higher taxes on the wealthy to pay for it

platforms.note: 2026 agenda is the 'New Affordability Agenda' (10 bills, April 29, 2026). 'Progressive Proposition' was the 2024 agenda for 2025.
planks: Government generic-drug discount program to cut prescription costs
Crack down on for-profit utilities overcharging customers
Windfall tax on oil companies' wartime profits, rebated to consumers
Cap childcare at 7% of family income
Build millions of homes, $20,000 first-time buyer down-payment aid, more rental assistance
Crack down on grocery price-fixing and seed-patent abuse
Two weeks guaranteed paid vacation for every worker
Ban surveillance pricing using personal data and AI
Double-time overtime pay
Abolish super PACs
